name: Tel Dreloth
summary: Tel Dreloth is a Telvanni mushroom tower situated along the southern edge of the Padomaic Crest. A chest can spawn to the left of the tower's front door. There's a garden on the north side of the tower. Softly-Glowing examines the bioluminescent mushrooms growing there. A copy of The Spotted Towers sits on a stool near her. Centipedes, rats, shroom beetles and torchbugs are found within. Hazards include lava pools and vile fungi.
